newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon tries to evacuate citizens from S.Leone.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon tries to evacuate citizens from S.Leone.

text.p: Lebanon sent a Boeing 707 plane to Africa on Tuesday in the hope of evacuating Lebanese citizens trapped since armed forces seized power in Sierra Leone.
The Middle East Airlines (MEA) plane, with a 150-person capacity, flew to Lagos, sources at Beirut airport said. It was then due to fly to Accra where it would wait for permission to fly to Freetown.
Foreign Minister Faris Bouez said on Monday two Lebanese citizens were killed and two wounded in the violence in Sierra Leone.

Many of the 2,000 Lebanese citizens living in the country, most of whom are businessmen, took shelter at the Lebanese embassy in Freetown but were suffering from shortages of food and water, Bouez said.
